Siding Services in Columbus, OH
Siding Services in Columbus, OH | Fast Repairs and Expert Installation

Bad siding does more than look rough. It lets water, pests, and cold air into your home. Columbus weather is hard on your walls. Cold winters, hot summers, and heavy rain wear siding down fast. When panels crack or pull loose, the damage behind them spreads.
Coldstream Exteriors fixes and installs siding for homes across Columbus, OH. Whether you need a full siding replacement or a quick panel repair, our licensed crew gets the job done right.
Call Coldstream Exteriors at (614) 812-0811 today to schedule siding services in Columbus, OH.
Your Trusted Local Siding Contractor in Columbus

Picking a siding contractor is a big choice. A bad install leads to gaps, leaks, and voided warranties. Coldstream Exteriors has earned the trust of over 3,000 homeowners across Central Ohio with steady, quality work.

We are a BBB A+ rated company with a 4.9-star rating from 400+ customer reviews . Every project comes with clear pricing. We take no money until the work is done. Our team is fully insured, and we back all siding work with written warranties.

Putting off siding work lets small issues grow. A cracked panel lets water behind the wall. Water leads to mold and wood rot inside the frame. Fixing siding damage early saves you thousands in bigger repairs later.
What to Expect During Your Siding Project
We keep the process clear from the first phone call to the final walkthrough.
Check your siding: We look at your current siding for cracks, water damage, and heat loss. We also check the boards and wrap behind the panels.
Pick your material: We walk you through the best options for your home. This includes vinyl siding , James Hardie siding , and fiber cement siding . Each type handles Ohio's weather in its own way.
Remove the old siding: Our crew strips the old panels and checks the wall behind them for rot or hidden water damage.
Prep and install: We fix any damaged boards, add a water barrier, and fit new siding panels to the maker's specs.
Final walkthrough: We clean up and walk you through the finished work. You sign off once you're happy with the results.
Our Siding Services in Columbus, OH
Siding Installation : New siding for new builds, home add-ons, or a full exterior upgrade. We install all major siding brands and types.
Siding Replacement : Full removal and swap of old, failing siding. We handle one wall or the whole house.
James Hardie Siding : A top-tier fiber cement board built to resist Ohio's freeze-thaw cycles, water, and UV rays. James Hardie boards come with a 30-year warranty.
Vinyl Siding : A budget-friendly, low-upkeep option. Today's vinyl resists fading, cracking, and dents.
Fiber Cement Siding : Tough, fire-safe panels made from a mix of cement, sand, and wood fiber. A great pick if you want a real wood look without the upkeep.
Soffit and Fascia Services : Soffit and fascia guard your roof edges from water and pests. We fix or swap out worn sections during any siding job.
Common Siding Problems We Fix
Cracking or splitting: Hard cold makes vinyl and wood siding crack. These cracks let water behind the panels and into the wall.
Warping or buckling: Trapped heat or poor nailing can warp siding. Warped spots create gaps that let in drafts and bugs.
Fading and color loss: Years of sun break down the color in siding. Uneven fading often means deeper wear beyond what you can see.
Mold and mildew: Dark spots or green streaks on your walls point to trapped water. This usually means the siding is failing and needs to be swapped out.
Loose or missing panels: Strong winds in Central Ohio pull siding off often. Missing panels leave the wall open to rain and wild temp changes.
High energy bills: Gaps behind old siding let heated or cooled air leak out. New siding with a proper water barrier can cut your energy costs.
Need more than just expert siding? Complete your home's exterior protection with professional soffit and fascia services that complement your new siding beautifully!
Our Proven Columbus Siding Installation Process
Frequently Asked Questions About Siding in Columbus
How long does vinyl siding usually last in the Ohio climate?

Good vinyl siding lasts 20 to 40 years in Central Ohio when put up the right way. Sun, storms, and upkeep all play a role in how long it holds up. Our team can look at your panels and tell you if a repair or full siding replacement makes more sense.
How long does siding installation take in Columbus?

Most residential siding installations take 3-7 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in 3-4 days, while larger two-story homes with complex architectural details typically take 5-7 days. Weather conditions can affect the timeline.
What siding materials do you recommend for Columbus homes?

Vinyl siding remains popular for Columbus homes due to its affordability and low maintenance. However, James Hardie fiber cement siding offers superior durability and curb appeal, lasting 30-50 years with excellent weather resistance. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
Do you handle siding installation for new construction projects?

Yes, we work with homeowners, builders, and contractors on new construction siding installation throughout Columbus. We coordinate with your construction timeline, deliver materials on schedule, and install your siding system according to code requirements and manufacturer specifications.

While it's technically possible to install over existing siding in some situations, we rarely recommend it. Complete removal and reinstallation lets us inspect your sheathing, replace damaged wood, ensure proper moisture barriers, and install new house wrap. This approach delivers better long-term performance and allows full manufacturer warranties.
How do I know if my contractor is properly insured and licensed?
Ask for proof of liability insurance and workers' comp coverage. A licensed contractor will share these papers without issue. You can check our info on our About Us page or call us to ask.

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, relocate outdoor furniture and planters away from the house, trim bushes close to exterior walls, and keep children and pets inside during installation. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.

Siding Installation in Columbus, OH
Professional Siding Installation Services in Columbus, Ohio

Your home deserves more than just any exterior covering. Whether you're building new construction, adding a garage, or installing completely new siding on your existing home, the quality of that installation determines everything. How long your siding lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional installation done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless installation creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to install new siding, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which materials actually perform well in Central Ohio's climate? How much insulation does your home really need? What housewrap provides real protection? Should you upgrade your sheathing? Do you need proper flashing, and if so, where? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between siding that performs beautifully for 30 years and one that fails in year seven.
Why Columbus Homeowners Need Reliable Siding Installation

Here's what separates professional siding installation from amateur work. The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We've torn off countless siding jobs that used premium materials but failed early because someone rushed the installation, skipped critical steps, or didn't understand proper flashing techniques.

Central Ohio's weather demands more from your siding than most people realize. Spring hailstorms test every panel's impact resistance. Summer heat cycles expand and contract materials thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every fastener's holding power. Winter freeze-thaw cycles push moisture into gaps where poor installation leaves openings. Your siding installation needs to handle all of this, year after year, without compromise.

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to install your new siding last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Small leaks around your windows during heavy rain. Panels buckling at the edges on hot days. Dark streaks appearing where moisture gets trapped under improperly installed trim. Your beautiful new siding is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.
Columbus's Most Trusted Siding Installation Services

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years installing siding that performs exactly as it should. We specialize in professional siding installation services that solve problems before they start instead of creating issues you'll fight later. We're not here to rush through your project and move to the next job. We're here to give you properly installed siding with quality materials, experienced installation crews, and guarantees that actually mean something.
Expert Siding Installation for Every Situation

Many Columbus homeowners come to us with different installation needs. Maybe you're finishing that detached garage you've been planning for years. Maybe you're building a new home and want the siding done right from day one. Maybe you're adding a second story or sunroom and need seamless integration with your existing exterior. Maybe your current siding is beyond repair and needs complete tear-off and reinstallation.

Here's exactly what happens. Call us for a free consultation and we'll come to your property within 24 hours to assess your project properly. We'll discuss your goals, explain your material options, answer every question thoroughly, and provide a detailed written estimate that covers everything. We've installed hundreds of siding projects across Columbus, and we know exactly what it takes to deliver results you can count on for decades.
